description.value: Choose fire, cold, radiation, or poison when you cast this. The target gains resistance 5 to the chosen damage type for the duration. In a world this contaminated, this is closer to a survival tool than a combat spell, and most Vigils know it.

cinderfall.incomplete: STRUCT-EFFECT-COMPANION: the rule element itself is trivial and real (Resistance {type: item|flags.system.rulesSelections.damageType, value: 5} paired with a ChoiceSet for the damage type, shape confirmed at pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/automaton/level-5/hardened-chassis.json), but no companion effect file exists in this corpus to hold it.
